notes: Added missing schema standardization, frontend rendering, and fallback handling stories for explainability completeness.

stories.title: Explainability Schema Definition (Pydantic Models)
stories.description: Define standardized Pydantic models for explainability objects (source, meaning, limitations, confidence optional) to enforce consistent structure across provider and clinical trial evaluation signals.

stories.title: Explainability Builder Core Logic
stories.description: Implement centralized builder/helper logic that constructs explainability objects from raw evaluation signals, including mapping data sources (NPI, ClinicalTrials.gov) and generating human-readable meaning and limitations.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Explainability Metadata
stories.description: Extend MessageBubble rendering to display explainability details (source links, interpretation text, and limitations) in a readable format within chat responses, preserving markdown safety and link validation.

stories.title: Explainability Fallback and Missing Data Handling
stories.description: Implement fallback logic for cases where source or limitations are unavailable, ensuring the system provides safe default messaging and avoids blank or misleading explainability fields.

stories.title: End-to-End Explainability Integration Validation
stories.description: Validate that explainability metadata flows end-to-end from domain services through facade to frontend rendering, including tool_router interactions and chat response formatting.
